content.content: Capture is read-run-read: the op head read before the run and again after; the two reads bound the run window, and capture keeps the entries within it, attributed to the invoking workspace. The run itself is untouched.
content.rationale: Capture is the only feed markers have; fixing read-run-read in the term keeps the bracketing independent of what the bracketed work does, and keeps the kept entries to the invoking workspace. The read capability stays where `ukrxptzm` put it.
